prompts.prompt: Edit/reference: exact original character from the supplied transparent sprite, flame skeletal knight with charcoal spiked armor, skull with red eyes, flame crown, ragged black cape and single orange rune sword held LOW. Make a coherent looping WALK CYCLE for a 2D RPG. Exactly EIGHT full-body animation frames in a regular FOUR columns by TWO rows sheet, read left-to-right then top row to bottom row. True TRANSPARENT alpha, no checkerboard, labels, text, lines, floor or shadows. This is ANIMATION, not eight similar standing portraits: BOTH LEGS must ALTERNATE forward/back, knees bend and feet lift. Locked camera, identical torso size and head height, identical sword low orientation, boots same size, torso stays centered. Small cyclic cape movement only. Phases: 1 near leg forward heel contact / far leg stretched back; 2 near leg supports flat / far heel lifting; 3 near supports upright / far bent knee passes under hips; 4 far leg swings forward / near heel lifts; 5 FAR leg forward heel contact / NEAR leg stretched back, clear OPPOSITE of frame1; 6 far supports flat / near heel lifting; 7 far supports upright / near bent knee passes hips; 8 near leg swings forward / far heel lifts and smoothly returns to frame1. Keep full sword and cape inside EACH cell with generous transparent margins, no overlap, no clipped tips. One consistent character drawing, do not use large flame effects, running, sliding feet or identical leg poses. Torso remains same pixel position in each cell; forward movement will be applied by game. All eight face front three-quarter down-right toward viewer. Skull face and chest visible. Distinguish left and right legs, full alternating cycle, especially frame1 versus frame5.
